name: Origin
description: See what AI agents are doing across your fleet — without leaving Claude. Origin Analytics connects Claude to your live endpoint telemetry through a typed analytics graph spanning endpoints, identities, sessions, prompts, and files. Ask in plain English which agents are running, who's using them, which prompts are being issued, and what files they're touching. Investigate suspicious sessions, audit AI usage for compliance, hunt shadow AI, or build adoption reports. Every answer comes from your real data — never inferred, never stale.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Origin to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Origin to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.prod.originhq.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Origin MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Origin provides these MCP tools: analytics_describe_schema and analytics_query.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Origin?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Origin in data on the Manufact MCP catalog include Aura, Clarivate IPOne CompuMark Trademarks, Enterpret, Motion Creative Analytics, and Nimble.
Origin requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Origin is developed by Origin. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
